text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
I-it really does look huge, doesn't it?
Will we really be okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
や、
やっぱり近くで見るとおっきい……
……本当に大丈夫かな？

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
It'll be fine, Kyoka.
If we work together, we can do anything!
text_block_list.orig_text:
大丈夫だよキョウカ。
力を合わせれば、
絶対勝てるよ！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
Yes, you're right... Thank you, Misogi!
With our powers combined,
we're stronger than any monster!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだよね……
ありがとうミソギ！
私たちが一つになれば、
どんな魔物にだって勝てるよね！
